gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3050 Ti Laptop GPU
exact_baseline: Fresh Qwen patch per admission, same score-encoding judge, no score noise; separately charged unsafe v1 arm. Compare descriptively to retained Qwen ARTT 96/128 and retain all eight old rows unchanged. Do not substitute fixture 88/128 as the live-model result.
repeated_backend: Replay the retained artt_score_attack public Qwen patch at matching trial index; fixed patch/task and new fixed canary across all filings and both paths. No new GPU inference for the repeated-release experiment. Count every protected replay-backend access; refusals must make zero accesses.
repeated_uncapped: Same noisy per-axis kernel p=0.5, v1 release path, one fresh release per filing, no admission cap. This isolates accumulation of residual score leakage. Exact-score uncapped baseline would already recover perfectly on filing one.
repeated_artt: Actual scheduled v2 publisher with p=0.5 and durable global plus per-item admission caps. 128 trials times four admitted filings = 512 admissions, then 1536 refusals. No cap reset, aliases or retrials.
canary_sampling: New balanced SystemRandom shuffle for exact baseline and another for repeated experiment; same repeated secret per trial in both paths, private schedules never persisted.
decoder: At each prefix count all categories 0 and 1 across both released axes; larger count wins (maximum likelihood for p=0.5); uniform seeded tie. Reuse the cap-prefix guess after cap, ignoring public refusals. Zero filings guesses zero, giving balanced chance exactly.
curve_prediction: Exact finite convolution of independent axis evidence (+1 with 1/2, -1 with 1/6, zero with 1/3) for 2*k axes; P(sum>0)+0.5*P(sum=0). ARTT prediction uses min(k,4). Observed curves may fluctuate; do not force monotonicity or select seeds/runs.
intervals: Pointwise Wilson 95% across 128 independent secret trials; successive filing points are correlated, not 16 independent experiments or simultaneous confidence bands.
timing_rationale: Replay is immediate custodian-local access; retained fixture timing meets the two-second judge resource limit. All timeouts and missing frames reported, no retries.
accounting: Carry the latest retained ARTT budget forward read-only; global allowance is predeclared 512 for this new cohort, item allowance four for each fixed secret. Both unsafe arms excluded from finite ARTT epsilon. Refused filings cost zero release epsilon.
reporting: One cohort, every prefix 0..16, preserve existing reports and ledgers byte-for-byte and all interrupted attempts. Report actual counts, diagnostics, verified ledgers, public patch provenance and before/after replay call counts. No rerun to improve recovery; no paper edits.
